name: Indian Chicken, Lentil & Chickpea Curry
source: Generated with Claude — Ninja Foodi example recipe
cook_method: Ninja Foodi — Sear/Sauté then Pressure Cook

ingredients.name: chicken thigh fillets, diced, trimmed of visible fat
salt-reduced chicken stock
ingredients.product: Massel Salt Reduced Chicken Style Liquid Stock 1L

method: Set the Ninja Foodi to Sear/Sauté on medium-high. Add the olive oil and onion, and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, turmeric, cumin and curry paste. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced chicken thigh and sear for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until no longer pink on the outside.
Add the crushed tomatoes, chicken stock, red lentils and drained chickpeas. Stir well, scraping any bits from the base of the pot.
Cancel Sear/Sauté. Fit the pressure lid, set the valve to Seal, and Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes.
While the curry cooks, prepare the basmati rice separately (rice cooker or stovetop absorption method).
Once cooking finishes, quick release the pressure. Stir in the coconut milk and baby spinach, and let sit for 2–3 minutes until the spinach wilts and the sauce thickens slightly.
Off the heat, whisk in the collagen protein powder until fully dissolved — it's unflavoured and heat-stable, so it disappears into the sauce.
Season to taste and serve over rice, topped with coriander and a squeeze of lime.

name: Indian High-Protein Chicken, Lentil & Bean Curry
cook_method: Ninja Foodi — Sear/Sauté, Pressure Cook, then Sear/Sauté to finish

ingredients.name: chicken thigh fillets, diced, trimmed of visible fat
chicken or vegetable stock
ingredients.product: Massel Salt Reduced Chicken Style Liquid Stock 1L

method: Sauté aromatics: On the Ninja Foodi Sear/Sauté (high) setting, heat the neutral oil or ghee. Add the onion, garlic and ginger, and cook 3–4 minutes until softened.
Bloom the spices: Stir in the curry powder or garam masala, cumin, coriander, turmeric, chilli powder, curry paste and tomato paste. Cook 1 minute until fragrant, stirring so nothing catches.
Sear the chicken: Add the diced chicken thigh and stir to coat in the spice paste, searing 2–3 minutes on the outside.
Add lentils, beans and hard veg: Add the red lentils, kidney beans, carrots, potatoes and salt, and pour in the stock. Stir well, scraping up any bits from the base of the pot.
Pressure cook: Lock the lid, set the valve to Seal, and Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes.
Release pressure: Let pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then carefully quick-release any remaining pressure.

Finish the vegetables: Switch to Sear/Sauté (medium). Stir in the zucchini, capsicum and cherry tomatoes. Simmer uncovered 5–8 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the curry has thickened to your liking.
Wilt the spinach: Stir through the baby spinach until just wilted, about 1 minute.
Stir through yoghurt: Turn off the heat. Spoon a ladle of hot curry into the yoghurt and mix to temper it, then stir this back into the pot (this stops it splitting). Taste and adjust seasoning.
Boost the protein: Whisk the collagen protein powder into the pot until fully dissolved — unflavoured and heat-stable, it disappears into the sauce.

name: High-Fibre Chicken & Red Lentil Soup
cook_method: Ninja Foodi — Sauté then Pressure Cook

ingredients.name: chicken stock
ingredients.product: Massel Salt Reduced Chicken Style Liquid Stock 1L

method: Sauté aromatics: Set the Ninja Foodi to Sauté (medium/high). Add the olive oil, then the onion, carrots and celery. Cook, stirring, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and chicken: Stir in the garlic and diced chicken thigh. Sauté for 2–3 minutes until the chicken is lightly seared on the outside.
Add remaining ingredients: Add the red lentils, diced tomatoes, chicken stock, cumin, smoked paprika, salt and black pepper. Stir well, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Pressure cook: Cancel Sauté. Seal the lid, set the valve to Seal, and Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes.
Release pressure: Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then carefully quick-release any remaining pressure.
Stir in kale: Open the lid, stir in the kale, and let it wilt in the residual heat for 2–3 minutes on Sauté/Keep Warm.
Boost the protein: Whisk in the collagen protein powder until fully dissolved — unflavoured and heat-stable, it disappears into the soup. Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

name: Thai Red Chicken, Lentil & Vegetable Curry

ingredients.name: chicken thigh fillets, diced, trimmed of visible fat
chicken or vegetable stock
ingredients.product: Massel Salt Reduced Chicken Style Liquid Stock 1L

method: Sauté aromatics: Set the Ninja Foodi to Sear/Sauté (high). Add the oil, onion and ginger-garlic paste, and cook 3–4 minutes until softened.
Bloom the curry paste: Stir in the red curry paste and cook 1–2 minutes, stirring, until fragrant and slightly darkened.
Sear the chicken: Add the diced chicken thigh and stir to coat in the paste, searing 3–4 minutes on the outside.
Add lentils, potato and stock: Add the red lentils, potato and stock. Stir well, scraping up any bits from the base of the pot.
Pressure cook: Cancel Sear/Sauté. Lock the lid, set the valve to Seal, and Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes.
Release pressure: Let pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then carefully quick-release any remaining pressure.
Finish the vegetables: Switch to Sear/Sauté (medium). Stir in the capsicum and eggplant, and simmer uncovered 6–8 minutes until tender and the curry has thickened.
Finish the sauce: Reduce heat, stir through the coconut milk, fish sauce and brown sugar, and simmer gently 2–3 minutes without boiling hard. Taste and adjust seasoning.

Boost the protein: Off the heat (or on low), whisk in the collagen protein powder until fully dissolved — it's unflavoured and heat-stable, so it disappears into the sauce without any taste, grain or clumping.
While the curry finishes, cook the jasmine rice separately (rice cooker or stovetop absorption method). Serve the curry over rice, topped with coriander, chilli and a squeeze of lime.

name: Chuck Beef & Lentil Bolognese
cook_method: Ninja Foodi — Sauté, Pressure Cook, then Sauté to finish

ingredients.name: chuck beef, trimmed of visible fat, diced small (ask your butcher for a lean trim)
reduced-sodium beef stock
ingredients.product: Massel Salt Reduced Beef Style Liquid Stock 1L

ingredients.name: whole-wheat spaghetti, cooked separately, to serve

method: Sauté the vegetables: Set the Ninja Foodi to Sauté (high). Heat the olive oil, then add the onion, carrot and celery. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened.
Add garlic: Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant.
Brown the beef: Add the diced chuck beef and brown on all sides, breaking up any large pieces.

Build the sauce: Stir in the tomato paste, oregano and basil, and cook 1 minute. Add the red lentils, crushed tomatoes, beef stock, mushrooms and bay leaves. Scrape any browned bits off the base of the pot.
Pressure cook: Cancel Sauté. Seal the lid, set the valve to Seal, and Pressure Cook on High for 15 minutes.
Release pressure: Let pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then carefully quick-release any remaining pressure.
Finish with spinach: Switch to Sauté. Stir in the baby spinach and cook until just wilted. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Boost the protein: Off the heat, whisk in the collagen protein powder until fully dissolved — unflavoured and heat-stable, it disappears into the sauce.
Remove the bay leaves. Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti separately according to packet directions, drain, and serve the bolognese spooned over the top.

name: Massaman Beef with Garlic Greens
source: Rex's recipe, brought over from a Claude chat conversation
cook_method: Ninja Foodi — Sear/Sauté then Pressure Cook, plus a wok for the greens

ingredients.name: beef chuck, trimmed, cut into 4cm cubes
Massaman curry paste (Maesri or Mae Ploy)
beef stock
ingredients.product: Massel Salt Reduced Beef Style Liquid Stock 1L

ingredients.name: waxy potatoes, cut into large chunks
gai lan or broccolini, stems split lengthways

method: Sear the beef: Set the Ninja Foodi to Sear/Sauté on High. Heat the coconut oil, then brown the beef chuck in two batches, about 4 minutes per batch. Set aside — don't crowd the pot, you want colour, not steam.
Fry the paste: Add the Massaman curry paste to the pot with a splash of the coconut milk. Fry 2–3 minutes until it darkens and smells toasty.

Deglaze and build: Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and the beef stock, scraping the base clean. Stir in the red lentils, fish sauce, palm sugar, tamarind concentrate, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods and bay leaves. Return the beef and any juices — the lentils will break down under pressure and thicken the sauce.
Pressure cook the beef: Lock the pressure lid with the valve sealed. Pressure Cook on High for 35 minutes, then quick release so the pot is still boiling when the potatoes go in.

Add potatoes and onion: Stir in the potatoes and onion. Lock the lid again and Pressure Cook on High for 5 minutes, then let it release naturally for 10 minutes before venting — a quick release here blows the potato chunks apart.

Reduce the curry: Remove the lid, switch to Sear/Sauté on Medium and simmer 8–10 minutes until the sauce coats a spoon. Fish out the cinnamon, cardamom and bay. Cook the rice separately (rice cooker or stovetop absorption method) and start the greens while this reduces.

Prep the greens: Mix the oyster sauce, light soy sauce, 3 tablespoons water and white pepper in a small bowl. Have all the vegetables cut and within reach before the wok goes on — the stir-fry cooks faster than you can chop.

Stir-fry the hard veg: Heat a wok or heavy frying pan over the highest heat until it just starts to smoke. Add the neutral oil and swirl, then the garlic for 15 seconds, no longer. Add the green beans and the thick stems of the gai lan, tossing for about 90 seconds.

Finish the greens: Add the capsicum and the leafy tops of the gai lan, then pour the sauce down the side of the pan. It should hiss hard. Toss for 2 minutes until the stems are bright green and still snap, then tip straight onto a platter so it stops cooking.
Finish and serve: Stir the lime juice through the curry. Taste: it should land sweet, salty and sour all at once. Serve over rice with the greens and lime wedges for squeezing.
